name: add-tasks
description: Add one or more tasks to a project, section, or parent. Supports assignment to project collaborators.

content.description: The task name/title. Should be concise and actionable (e.g., "Review PR #123", "Call dentist"). For longer content, use the description field instead. Supports Markdown.

description.description: Additional details, notes, or context for the task. Use this for longer content rather than putting it in the task name. Supports Markdown.

priority.description: Task priority as a string: "p1" (highest), "p2" (high), "p3" (medium), or "p4" (lowest/default). Integers like 1, 2, 3, or 4 are not accepted.

dueString.description: The due date for the task, in natural language.

deadlineDate.description: The deadline date for the task in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD, e.g., "2025-12-31"). Deadlines are immovable constraints shown with a different indicator than due dates.

duration.description: The duration of the task. Use format: "2h" (hours), "90m" (minutes), "2h30m" (combined), or "1.5h" (decimal hours). Max 24h.

labels.description: The labels to attach to the task.

projectId.description: The project ID to add this task to. Project ID should be an ID string, or the text "inbox", for inbox tasks.

sectionId.description: The section ID to add this task to.

parentId.description: The parent task ID (for subtasks).

order.description: Position of the task among sibling tasks under the same parent/section.

responsibleUser.description: Assign task to this user. Can be "me" (assigns to current user), a user ID, name, or email address. User must be a collaborator on the target project.

isUncompletable.description: Whether this task should be uncompletable (organizational header). Tasks with isUncompletable: true appear as organizational headers and cannot be completed.

tasks.description: The array of tasks to add (max 25).

id.description: The unique ID of the task.

dueDate.description: The due date of the task (ISO 8601 format).

recurring.description: Whether the task is recurring, or the recurrence string.

deadlineDate.description: The deadline date of the task (ISO 8601 format).

priority.description: The priority level: p1 (highest), p2 (high), p3 (medium), p4 (lowest).

projectId.description: The ID of the project this task belongs to.

sectionId.description: The ID of the section this task belongs to.

parentId.description: The ID of the parent task (for subtasks).

labels.description: The labels attached to this task.

responsibleUid.description: The UID of the user responsible for this task.

isUncompletable.description: Whether the task is uncompletable (organizational header).

assignedByUid.description: The UID of the user who assigned this task.

completedAt.description: When the task was completed (ISO 8601 format).

totalCount.description: The total number of tasks created.

item.description: The item that failed (usually an ID or identifier).

failures.description: Failed task creations with error details.

totalRequested.description: The total number of tasks requested.

successCount.description: The number of successfully created tasks.

failureCount.description: The number of failed task creations.

name: reschedule-tasks
description: Reschedule tasks to new dates while preserving recurring schedules. Unlike update-tasks (which replaces the entire due string and can wipe recurrence), this tool changes only the date, keeping recurrence patterns intact. Use this when moving recurring tasks to a different date without altering their repeat pattern.

searchText.description: The text to search for in tasks.

parentId.description: Find subtasks of this parent task.

responsibleUser.description: Find tasks assigned to this user. Can be a user ID, name, or email address.
